curator_notes: All 32 prize winners are analyzed records. The general top three are ranked; sponsor challenges with several winners stay unranked track-winner because project pages do not show the order. Many entries answer the sponsor challenges (lost-and-found, security triage, adaptive banking, portal automation), so the roster clusters around them. Taglines are CrafterWIKI paraphrases; domains assigned conservatively.
